response.title: Aakhri Chitthi: Why Did She Leave?
response.hook: If I told you, you'd hate someone else instead of me. I chose me.
response.positioning: A sibling showdown over a secret that one of them has kept for six years.
response.rationale: Recorded plan: fast cuts between conflict beats, ending on the strongest emotional line. Repair 1: CLIP_003 replaced because SC10 exceeds the young-adult spoiler ceiling.

clips.reason: Arjun and Meera's rooftop clash (DLG_023 'I chose me', DLG_024) is the core sibling conflict; SC05 scored 79 with young adults in CMP_PRELAUNCH_CLIPS.
Meera confronting Raghav in the storeroom (DLG_031) raises the question of what he is hiding.

Replaces the SC10 reveal clip (SPOILER_LEVEL_EXCEEDED) and keeps its purpose as the closing emotional beat: Arjun's cold welcome 'Guests usually send word before they come.' (DLG_006) and Meera's hurt reply (DLG_007) carry the sibling rift without revealing why she left.
